title: Exercise interactive and non-interactive invocations
statement: As a developer building tools around AI harnesses, I can send input to the real binary in the invocation modes and with the flags my application uses so that my tests exercise its actual process integration.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A consumer can exercise the real binary with input in its supported interactive mode against the mock provider.
A consumer can exercise the real binary with input in its supported non-interactive mode against the mock provider.
A consumer can exercise the binary with consumer-selected flags supported by that binary and compatible with the mock-provider connection.
